css: body{font-family:'Nunito','Manrope','Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif}.copy{text-align:center}.badge{display:inline-block;font-weight:800;font-size:32px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:20px}h1{font-weight:900;font-size:var(--title);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink);text-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}h1 em{font-style:normal;font-family:'Caveat',cursive;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);font-size:1.3em;line-height:.8;display:inline-block;transform:rotate(-3deg)}p{font-size:44px;line-height:1.4;margin:26px auto 0;max-width:960px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}.el-crop{box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)!important}
